general.host.enabledCheck.label: Enable Cyrus Scatter
general.host.enabledCheck.help: Enable calculation and output for this entire Scatter setup.

general.updateUI.updateRadio.label: Viewport update
general.updateUI.updateRadio.help: Manual keeps the last complete planting until an explicit Update. Live schedules a new result after relevant changes; browsing and unrelated scene changes should not generate placements.

general.previewUI.previewCheck.label: Show preview
general.previewUI.previewCheck.help: Show or hide the Scatter viewport preview. This display switch does not delete accepted plants or disable the layer recipe.

general.previewUI.displayModeDrop.label: Display mode
general.previewUI.displayModeDrop.help: Choose Point Cloud, Proxy, Mesh, Placement points or Textured mesh. Placement points shows one marker per accepted placement. Textured mesh uses supported source materials and cutout opacity with Mesh triangle budgets.

general.previewUI.proxyShapeDrop.label: Proxy shape
general.previewUI.proxyShapeDrop.help: Choose Box, Sphere or Pyramid for Proxy display. These are simplified viewport shapes, not replacement render models or a collision-mesh setting.

general.previewUI.instancesLimitSpin.label: Idle instances
general.previewUI.instancesLimitSpin.help: Maximum proxy instances when the view settles, across visible layers. Zero removes the display cap.

general.previewUI.faceLimitSpin.label: Idle triangles
general.previewUI.faceLimitSpin.help: Maximum Mesh triangles when the view settles, across visible layers. Expensive sources may use cached boxes. Zero removes the display cap; resource safeguards still apply.

general.previewUI.identificationDrop.label: Color by
general.previewUI.identificationDrop.help: Use Model, Layer or Bands identification colors in nontextured display modes. Choose Textured mesh in Display mode for materials and textures.

general.previewUI.pointColorRadio.label: Preview color
general.previewUI.pointColorRadio.help: Choose one Solid Color or model/layer Identification Colors for the preview. Assignment-group colors and source weights remain separate.

general.previewUI.solidColorPicker.label: Solid preview color
general.previewUI.solidColorPicker.help: Choose the preview color used when Solid Color is selected. This does not edit source materials or assignment groups.

general.previewUI.budgetSpin.label: Idle points
general.previewUI.budgetSpin.help: Maximum Point Cloud or centre markers when the view settles, across visible layers. Zero removes the display cap.

general.previewUI.pointsSpin.label: Points/plant
general.previewUI.pointsSpin.help: Set the number of source-geometry samples used to represent each plant in Point Cloud mode. Plant centres uses one centre marker instead; neither setting creates more plants.

general.previewUI.radiusLimitSpin.label: Radii / layer
general.previewUI.radiusLimitSpin.help: Limit how many enabled source-radius overlays are shown per layer. Zero hides these overlays; this display limit does not change collision radii.

general.previewUI.radiusAllCheck.label: Show All Radii
general.previewUI.radiusAllCheck.help: Show all enabled radius overlays instead of applying the Radii / layer limit. The collision settings are unchanged.

general.previewUI.iconSpin.label: Icon size
general.previewUI.iconSpin.help: Set the world-space size of the Scatter controller icon. This changes its scene helper, not plant scale or brush size.

general.previewUI.refreshButton.label: Refresh preview
general.previewUI.refreshButton.help: Explicitly refresh enabled layers and their preview from current settings. This calls the setup update, so it can publish pending edits in Manual mode; it is not a passive statistics read.

general.previewUI.autoRenderCheck.label: Automatic final render
general.previewUI.autoRenderCheck.help: Enable the automatic final-render bridge for the completed planting. Viewport representation and budgets remain separate; renderer and material combinations still require qualification.

general.previewUI.clearBakedButton.label: Remove old baked output
general.previewUI.clearBakedButton.help: Delete this setup's owned baked scene output while preserving original sources. The action re-enables preview and automatic final rendering; it is an output-cleanup action, not a Bake button.

general.surface.receiversList.label: Surfaces
general.surface.receiversList.help: List the selected layer's linked receiving surfaces. Highlight rows to unlink them; the list is distinct from source models and Paint Area targets.

general.surface.removeSurfaces.label: Remove selected surfaces
general.surface.removeSurfaces.help: Unlink highlighted receivers from the selected layer without deleting scene objects. Paint Areas targeting a removed receiver remain inactive with saved borders until that same node is restored.

general.surface.sharedPick.label: Pick receiving surface
general.surface.sharedPick.help: Add a receiving surface without replacing existing assignments.

general.surface.surfacesButton.label: Receiving surfaces...
general.surface.surfacesButton.help: Add multiple receiving surfaces by name. Existing assignments are kept. Choose the target for each Paint Area under Painting.

general.surface.containersToggle.label: Global source containers
general.surface.containersToggle.help: Show or hide the setup's optional global source-palette controls. A consuming layer must choose Global containers in its Models source-pool control; this disclosure does not enable rectangle collection.

general.surface.globalContainers.label: Global source containers
general.surface.globalContainers.help: List rectangles linked to the setup's global source pool. Select one before unlinking it. Layers use the pool only when their source-pool mode is Global containers.

general.surface.createContainer.label: Create source rectangle
general.surface.createContainer.help: Create and link a global source rectangle with collection disabled. Position it first, then enable collection; only layers using the global pool consume its eligible models.

general.surface.pickContainer.label: Pick source rectangle
general.surface.pickContainer.help: Link an existing Cyrus Source Container to the global pool.

general.surface.removeContainer.label: Unlink selected rectangle
general.surface.removeContainer.help: Unlink the rectangle while keeping its scene node and registered model settings.

general.manager.layerList.label: Layer | placed | status
general.manager.layerList.help: Select the layer whose surfaces, models, amount and rules are being edited. The listed order controls evaluation; selecting a layer alone does not request new planting.

general.manager.addButton.label: Add layer
general.manager.addButton.help: Add a layer and edit its controls below. Layers calculate from top to bottom.

general.manager.copyButton.label: Copy
general.manager.copyButton.help: Copy this layer, its models, surfaces and Paint Areas.

general.manager.removeButton.label: Remove
general.manager.removeButton.help: Remove this layer and its Paint Areas. Undo restores them.

general.manager.layerColor.label: Layer identification color
general.manager.layerColor.help: Identification color for this layer. Choose Layer colors in Viewport & render to display it.

general.manager.nameEdit.label: Layer name
general.manager.nameEdit.help: Rename the selected layer without changing its identity.

general.manager.visibleCheck.label: Visible in viewport
general.manager.visibleCheck.help: Hide display only. Hidden layers still calculate and affect spacing.

general.manager.enabledCheck.label: Enabled in output
general.manager.enabledCheck.help: Include this layer in calculation and final output.

general.manager.upButton.label: Move up
general.manager.upButton.help: Evaluate earlier; earlier layers occupy space first.

general.diagnostics.startButton.label: Start recording
general.diagnostics.startButton.help: Record engineering events in this Max process. Off by default; at most ten minutes, 4,096 events and 4 MiB.

general.diagnostics.stopButton.label: Stop
general.diagnostics.stopButton.help: Stop recording and retain the bounded history in memory.

general.diagnostics.saveButton.label: Save report...
general.diagnostics.saveButton.help: Choose a local JSON file, stop recording and save retained events, inclusive stage totals, action IDs and a passive cached setup snapshot. Stage times can overlap; they are not viewport FPS. No MCP or upload is required.

general.diagnostics.refreshButton.label: Read recording status
general.diagnostics.refreshButton.help: Read recorder state without evaluating the scene. Status has no polling timer.

layer.setsUI.paintedCheck.label: Use Paint Areas
layer.setsUI.paintedCheck.help: Restrict this layer to its painted areas. Turn off to scatter across all its surfaces.

layer.setsUI.setList.label: Selected Paint Area
layer.setsUI.setList.help: Choose the named Paint Area to edit. Each area targets one receiver and shares its layer's models and amount; selection alone does not add plants or create another quota.
layer.setsUI.setList.owner_context: Selected Paint Area of the layer

layer.setsUI.addButton.label: Add Paint Area (+)
layer.setsUI.addButton.help: Create a named area. Painting again edits the selected area.

layer.setsUI.removeButton.label: Remove
layer.setsUI.removeButton.help: Remove the selected area. Undo restores it.
layer.setsUI.removeButton.owner_context: Selected Paint Area of the layer

layer.setsUI.nameEdit.label: Paint Area name
layer.setsUI.nameEdit.help: Rename the selected Paint Area without changing its identity, target or vector borders.
layer.setsUI.nameEdit.owner_context: Selected Paint Area of the layer

layer.setsUI.targetList.label: Surface
layer.setsUI.targetList.help: Explicit target within this layer. An area with saved paint cannot be silently retargeted.
layer.setsUI.targetList.owner_context: Selected Paint Area of the layer

layer.setsUI.enabledCheck.label: Enable Paint Area
layer.setsUI.enabledCheck.help: Include or exclude the selected Paint Area's coverage while preserving its saved borders. Enabled overlapping areas union coverage within the layer, so overlap does not duplicate candidates.
layer.setsUI.enabledCheck.owner_context: Selected Paint Area of the layer

layer.sourceUI.sourceName.label: Source label
layer.sourceUI.sourceName.help: Label inside Scatter only. Clear it to use the scene object's name.
layer.sourceUI.sourceName.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.idColor.label: Model identification color
layer.sourceUI.idColor.help: Viewport identification color. This does not change clustering or model frequency.
layer.sourceUI.idColor.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.plantList.label: Sources (Ctrl/Shift)
layer.sourceUI.plantList.help: Select one or more registered source rows with Ctrl/Shift. Source properties affect these rows; scene selection and assignment-group selection are separate.
layer.sourceUI.plantList.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.selectFromScene.label: Choose from list...
layer.sourceUI.selectFromScene.help: Choose one or more source models by name.
layer.sourceUI.selectFromScene.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.addPlant.label: + (add model)
layer.sourceUI.addPlant.help: Use + below Models & Points to pick and add an eligible scene object as a model source. Add Point is beside Make point.
layer.sourceUI.addPlant.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.removePlant.label: Remove rows
layer.sourceUI.removePlant.help: Unregister highlighted rows. To keep their settings, park models outside a source rectangle instead.
layer.sourceUI.removePlant.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.selectPlant.label: Select sources
layer.sourceUI.selectPlant.help: Select the highlighted source models in the scene.
layer.sourceUI.selectPlant.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.addPoint.label: Add Point
layer.sourceUI.addPoint.help: Add a Point placeholder that can accept placements without final model geometry and can later be replaced by a model. Candidate budget and Accepted target both support Points; use Plant centres to inspect point-only layouts.
layer.sourceUI.addPoint.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.addEmpty.label: Add Empty
layer.sourceUI.addEmpty.help: Add a weighted Empty choice for intentional gaps in Candidate budget mode. Accepted target rejects positive-weight Empty rows instead of refilling those gaps; Point is a different source kind.
layer.sourceUI.addEmpty.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.replacePoint.label: Pick object
layer.sourceUI.replacePoint.help: Replace one selected Point or existing model with an unused scene object while preserving its row identity, settings and Band assignments. The original scene object remains. Duplicate sources and receiver picks are rejected.

layer.sourceUI.existingGroups.label: Reuse a group
layer.sourceUI.existingGroups.help: Assign highlighted sources to an existing color group for clustering.
layer.sourceUI.existingGroups.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.groupColor.label: Assignment-group color
layer.sourceUI.groupColor.help: Assign a color group to highlighted sources when the color is accepted.
layer.sourceUI.groupColor.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.applyColor.label: Apply to selected rows
layer.sourceUI.applyColor.help: Assign the chosen color group to all highlighted source rows.
layer.sourceUI.applyColor.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.weightSpin.label: Weight
layer.sourceUI.weightSpin.help: Relative model frequency in this layer. Zero disables the model.
layer.sourceUI.weightSpin.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.sourceZSpin.label: Z Offset
layer.sourceUI.sourceZSpin.help: Offset instances of highlighted models along their placement normal.
layer.sourceUI.sourceZSpin.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.sourceScaleSpin.label: Scale
layer.sourceUI.sourceScaleSpin.help: Per-model scale multiplier. 1 keeps the model's original scale.
layer.sourceUI.sourceScaleSpin.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.radiusSourceSpin.label: Radius
layer.sourceUI.radiusSourceSpin.help: Saved Manual collision radius for highlighted source rows, in scene units. Auto disables this control and preserves its value for returning to Manual.
layer.sourceUI.radiusSourceSpin.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.followRadiusCheck.label: Follow Scale
layer.sourceUI.followRadiusCheck.help: Apply instance scaling to the saved Manual radius. Auto already uses the final basis once, so this setting is disabled but preserved in Auto.
layer.sourceUI.followRadiusCheck.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.showRadiusCheck.label: Show Radius
layer.sourceUI.showRadiusCheck.help: Show this source's radius in the viewport; does not change collision rules.
layer.sourceUI.showRadiusCheck.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.forwardAxis.label: Forward axis
layer.sourceUI.forwardAxis.help: The model's local forward direction, used for orientation.
layer.sourceUI.forwardAxis.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceUI.detailsToggle.label: Point / Empty sources and color groups
layer.sourceUI.detailsToggle.help: Show or hide these advanced controls; their saved settings are preserved.
layer.sourceUI.detailsToggle.owner_context: Selected source rows of the layer

layer.sourceContainersUI.modeList.label: Source pool
layer.sourceContainersUI.modeList.help: Use the model list directly, or optionally collect models from source rectangles.
layer.sourceContainersUI.modeList.owner_context: Selected layer source pool / linked rectangle

layer.sourceContainersUI.containersList.label: Rectangles
layer.sourceContainersUI.containersList.help: List rectangles linked directly to this layer. Select a rectangle to change its collection switch or unlink it. Global-container mode uses the separate setup pool.
layer.sourceContainersUI.containersList.owner_context: Selected layer source pool / linked rectangle

layer.sourceContainersUI.enabledCheck.label: Enable collection
layer.sourceContainersUI.enabledCheck.help: Enable the selected rectangle to collect models. New rectangles start off so you can position them first. Manual mode needs Update.
layer.sourceContainersUI.enabledCheck.owner_context: Selected layer source pool / linked rectangle

layer.sourceContainersUI.createContainer.label: Create container
layer.sourceContainersUI.createContainer.help: Create an inactive source rectangle. Position it around model pivots, then enable collection.
layer.sourceContainersUI.createContainer.owner_context: Selected layer source pool / linked rectangle

layer.sourceContainersUI.pickContainer.label: Pick boundary
layer.sourceContainersUI.pickContainer.help: Link a Cyrus container, or copy a square-corner Rectangle into a container. The original spline is preserved.
layer.sourceContainersUI.pickContainer.owner_context: Selected layer source pool / linked rectangle

layer.sourceContainersUI.removeContainer.label: Unlink selected rectangle
layer.sourceContainersUI.removeContainer.help: Unlink this rectangle without deleting it or registered source settings.
layer.sourceContainersUI.removeContainer.owner_context: Selected layer source pool / linked rectangle

layer.distributionUI.modeRadio.label: Method
layer.distributionUI.modeRadio.help: Choose Random eligibility or Texture Density. Texture Density samples a selected map through the selected receiver UV channel; it is independent of Random mix/Clusters/Spline bands model assignment in Layout.

layer.distributionUI.populationRadio.label: Population
layer.distributionUI.populationRadio.help: Choose a fixed requested Count shared across receivers or Plants per m2 density. Counts are bounded requests before masks, spacing and cleanup, so accepted output can be smaller.

layer.distributionUI.countSpin.label: Requested count
layer.distributionUI.countSpin.help: Layer population before eligibility, up to 1,000,000 within the shared controller candidate budget. Accepted target can retry up to its limits.

layer.distributionUI.densitySpin.label: Per m2
layer.distributionUI.densitySpin.help: Requested plants per square metre of receiving surface. Each population and the shared controller candidate budget are bounded at 1,000,000, including retries.

layer.distributionUI.seedSpin.label: Seed
layer.distributionUI.seedSpin.help: Deterministic generation seed. Changing it can invalidate existing Edit bindings.

layer.distributionUI.densityButton.label: Choose density map
layer.distributionUI.densityButton.help: Use the selected receiver UV channel: white permits candidates, black excludes them, and gray thins them. UVs clamp to 0..1.

layer.distributionUI.invertCheck.label: Invert density
layer.distributionUI.invertCheck.help: Reverse the density map's white and black eligibility.

layer.populationPolicyUI.populationList.label: Layer population
layer.populationPolicyUI.populationList.help: Budget evaluates the generated candidates; target makes bounded replacement attempts.

layer.populationPolicyUI.attemptSpin.label: Attempt factor
layer.populationPolicyUI.attemptSpin.help: Maximum candidate attempts as a multiple of the requested population.

layer.populationPolicyUI.roundSpin.label: Max rounds
layer.populationPolicyUI.roundSpin.help: Maximum rounds of eligibility, collision and cleanup. A shortfall can remain.

layer.populationPolicyUI.repairCheck.label: Retry cleanup gaps
layer.populationPolicyUI.repairCheck.help: Allow bounded retries for plants removed by final cleanup.

layer.areaUI.areaList.label: Closed lines / shapes
layer.areaUI.areaList.help: Select linked Include/Exclude shapes. Their row prefixes show the stored modes. One selected line can also expose its independent falloff settings; selecting an area is not painting.

layer.areaUI.addAreaScene.label: Select From Scene...
layer.areaUI.addAreaScene.help: Choose closed Area shapes by name.

layer.areaUI.pickArea.label: Add: pick closed line
layer.areaUI.pickArea.help: Link a closed shape as a layer-wide world-XY mask. New links default to Include; select the row before changing its mode. All Paint Areas and ordinary planting in this layer obey these limits.

layer.areaUI.removeArea.label: Remove selected rows
layer.areaUI.removeArea.help: Unlink highlighted Areas and their falloff settings; keep the scene shapes.

layer.areaUI.areaMode.label: Selected area mode
layer.areaUI.areaMode.help: Set the highlighted area rows to Include or Exclude. Include domains union and Exclude wins; with no selected row, changing the radio changes no saved area.

layer.areaUI.refreshAreas.label: Refresh areas / preview
layer.areaUI.refreshAreas.help: Explicitly update current area geometry and recalculate the owning setup's enabled layers. This can publish pending Manual edits; it is not a passive redraw.

layer.areaUI.aaPick.label: Pick Surface Analyzer
layer.areaUI.aaPick.help: Choose an existing Cyrus Surface Analyzer for line or point masks.

layer.areaUI.aaRemove.label: Remove Area Analyzer
layer.areaUI.aaRemove.help: Disable and unlink the layer's Analyzer Area mask.

layer.areaUI.aaLine.label: Center Line
layer.areaUI.aaLine.help: Use the Analyzer centre line as an XY mask; unions with its point mask.

layer.areaUI.aaWidth.label: Full width
layer.areaUI.aaWidth.help: Full width of the Analyzer centre-line Area mask.

layer.areaUI.aaCaps.label: Line ends
layer.areaUI.aaCaps.help: Flat or round ends for the line mask.

layer.areaUI.aaStreetOffset.label: Street offset
layer.areaUI.aaStreetOffset.help: Shift the Analyzer centre-line mask in world XY relative to the nearest street segment: positive away, negative toward. A nonzero value requires street data; Layout shares this layer setting.

layer.areaUI.aaPoints.label: Points
layer.areaUI.aaPoints.help: Use discs around Analyzer points as an XY mask.

layer.areaUI.aaRadius.label: Radius
layer.areaUI.aaRadius.help: Radius of each Analyzer point mask.

layer.areaUI.fallTarget.label: Edge falloff target
layer.areaUI.fallTarget.help: Edit Analyzer boundary falloff or one highlighted Area's independent falloff.

layer.areaUI.fallPick.label: Pick Surface Analyzer
layer.areaUI.fallPick.help: Choose the Analyzer whose boundary drives this falloff.

layer.areaUI.fallRemove.label: Remove Analyzer
layer.areaUI.fallRemove.help: Unlink the falloff Analyzer and disable its falloff effects.

layer.areaUI.fallDeleteCheck.label: Delete edge band
layer.areaUI.fallDeleteCheck.help: Exclude an edge band before scale and density ramps begin.

layer.areaUI.fallDeleteSpin.label: Delete width
layer.areaUI.fallDeleteSpin.help: Width of the excluded edge band in scene units.

layer.areaUI.fallScaleCheck.label: Scale ramp
layer.areaUI.fallScaleCheck.help: Vary instance scale with distance from this boundary.

layer.areaUI.fallScaleSpin.label: Scale width
layer.areaUI.fallScaleSpin.help: Distance over which the scale curve is evaluated.

layer.areaUI.fallDensityCheck.label: Density ramp
layer.areaUI.fallDensityCheck.help: Vary candidate eligibility with distance from this boundary.

layer.areaUI.fallDensitySpin.label: Density width
layer.areaUI.fallDensitySpin.help: Distance over which the density curve is evaluated.

layer.areaUI.detailsToggle.label: Analyzer masks and edge falloff
layer.areaUI.detailsToggle.help: Show or hide these advanced controls; their saved settings are preserved.

layer.brushUI.modeRadio.label: Brush
layer.brushUI.modeRadio.help: Paint unions a swept region into the selected area; Erase subtracts coverage and can cut holes. Repeated gestures edit the same vector document rather than adding a stroke-history stack.

layer.brushUI.radiusSpin.label: Radius
layer.brushUI.radiusSpin.help: Distance from the brush center to its edge. A 100 mm radius paints a 200 mm wide stroke.

layer.brushUI.beginButton.label: Start Brush
layer.brushUI.beginButton.help: Start painting the selected area on its explicit receiver and enable painted coverage for the layer. The receiver must be linked to this layer and supported terrain or manifold curved geometry; Manual planting still waits for Update.

layer.brushUI.stopButton.label: Stop
layer.brushUI.stopButton.help: End the active brush session and keep completed vector edits. This stops authoring; it does not clear the area.

layer.brushUI.fillButton.label: Fill
layer.brushUI.fillButton.help: Fill the selected area's supported receiver footprint. Layer masks, spacing and other acceptance constraints still apply to planting; Manual mode needs Update.

layer.brushUI.emptyButton.label: Clear
layer.brushUI.emptyButton.help: Clear the selected area's vector coverage while keeping the area, target and other settings. Other areas remain independent; Manual mode needs Update.

layer.brushUI.densitySpin.label: Area density %
layer.brushUI.densitySpin.help: Multiply this area's candidate eligibility by Area density percentage. It does not create a separate population; overlapping areas use the strongest effective density and admit a candidate only once.

layer.brushUI.overlayMode.label: Paint feedback
layer.brushUI.overlayMode.help: Choose cached Vector borders, bounded Coverage samples or Off for painting feedback. Feedback is a diagnostic/display choice and does not change the allowed planting region.

layer.brushUI.overlayColor.label: Paint feedback color
layer.brushUI.overlayColor.help: Choose the selected area's painting-feedback color. This is independent of source identification colors, grouping colors and render materials.

layer.brushUI.insideSpin.label: Inside fade
layer.brushUI.insideSpin.help: Set how far the feather transition extends inside the vector border. Combined with Outside fade it defines the transition span; both zero gives a hard edge. Widths use the transformed projection plane, not slope distance.

layer.brushUI.outsideSpin.label: Outside fade
layer.brushUI.outsideSpin.help: Set how far the feather transition extends outside the vector border. It cannot plant beyond the receiver or defeat an Exclude mask; both fade widths zero gives a hard edge.

layer.brushUI.densityFade.label: Fade density
layer.brushUI.densityFade.help: Apply the Density curve across the inside/outside feather transition to thin stable candidates. This can be enabled independently of Fade scale.

layer.brushUI.densityCurve.label: Density curve...
layer.brushUI.densityCurve.help: Edit the selected Paint Area's normalized feather-density curve. Left is the outer transition edge; right is fully interior. Graph edits save immediately; closing the graph is not Cancel.

layer.brushUI.scaleFade.label: Fade scale
layer.brushUI.scaleFade.help: Apply the Scale curve between Edge scale and Inner scale as a multiplier on existing instance scale. This can be enabled independently of Fade density.

layer.brushUI.scaleMin.label: Edge scale
layer.brushUI.scaleMin.help: With the default Scale curve, set the outer-end size multiplier. 0.5 means half size and 1 unchanged. It multiplies existing model/random scale when Fade scale is enabled and must not exceed Inner scale. A custom curve can change the endpoint response.

layer.brushUI.scaleMax.label: Inner scale
layer.brushUI.scaleMax.help: With the default Scale curve, set the interior size multiplier. 1 means unchanged and 2 double size. It must be at least Edge scale. A custom curve controls the endpoint response; this is independent of density fading.

layer.brushUI.scaleCurve.label: Scale curve...
layer.brushUI.scaleCurve.help: Edit the separate normalized curve that blends Edge scale to Inner scale across the feather transition. Graph edits commit as edited; it does not replace the Density curve.

layer.randomUI.rotXMinSpin.label: X rotation min
layer.randomUI.rotXMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random X-axis rotation in degrees. Equal minimum and maximum give a fixed value; normal alignment and model forward-axis settings affect final orientation.

layer.randomUI.rotXMaxSpin.label: X rotation max
layer.randomUI.rotXMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random X-axis rotation in degrees. Equal minimum and maximum give a fixed value; normal alignment and model forward-axis settings affect final orientation.

layer.randomUI.rotYMinSpin.label: Y rotation min
layer.randomUI.rotYMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random Y-axis rotation in degrees. Equal minimum and maximum give a fixed value; normal alignment and model forward-axis settings affect final orientation.

layer.randomUI.rotYMaxSpin.label: Y rotation max
layer.randomUI.rotYMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random Y-axis rotation in degrees. Equal minimum and maximum give a fixed value; normal alignment and model forward-axis settings affect final orientation.

layer.randomUI.rotZMinSpin.label: Z rotation min
layer.randomUI.rotZMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random Z-axis rotation in degrees. Equal minimum and maximum give a fixed value; normal alignment and model forward-axis settings affect final orientation.

layer.randomUI.rotZMaxSpin.label: Z rotation max
layer.randomUI.rotZMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random Z-axis rotation in degrees. Equal minimum and maximum give a fixed value; normal alignment and model forward-axis settings affect final orientation.

layer.randomUI.sclXMinSpin.label: X scale min
layer.randomUI.sclXMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random X-axis scale multiplier. 1 is unchanged; per-model, whole-scale and enabled falloff multipliers also contribute.

layer.randomUI.sclXMaxSpin.label: X scale max
layer.randomUI.sclXMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random X-axis scale multiplier. 1 is unchanged; per-model, whole-scale and enabled falloff multipliers also contribute.

layer.randomUI.sclYMinSpin.label: Y scale min
layer.randomUI.sclYMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random Y-axis scale multiplier. 1 is unchanged; per-model, whole-scale and enabled falloff multipliers also contribute.

layer.randomUI.sclYMaxSpin.label: Y scale max
layer.randomUI.sclYMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random Y-axis scale multiplier. 1 is unchanged; per-model, whole-scale and enabled falloff multipliers also contribute.

layer.randomUI.sclZMinSpin.label: Z scale min
layer.randomUI.sclZMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random Z-axis scale multiplier. 1 is unchanged; per-model, whole-scale and enabled falloff multipliers also contribute.

layer.randomUI.sclZMaxSpin.label: Z scale max
layer.randomUI.sclZMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random Z-axis scale multiplier. 1 is unchanged; per-model, whole-scale and enabled falloff multipliers also contribute.

layer.randomUI.wholeMinSpin.label: Uniform scale minimum
layer.randomUI.wholeMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of an additional uniform scale multiplier applied equally to all axes. 1 is unchanged; this does not reset separate XYZ or per-model scale.

layer.randomUI.wholeMaxSpin.label: Uniform scale maximum
layer.randomUI.wholeMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of an additional uniform scale multiplier applied equally to all axes. Matching limits give a fixed multiplier.

layer.randomUI.movXMinSpin.label: X movement min
layer.randomUI.movXMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random X-axis translation in scene world units. Keep on surface can project moved candidates back to their receiver; painting requires projected movement when movement is nonzero.

layer.randomUI.movXMaxSpin.label: X movement max
layer.randomUI.movXMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random X-axis translation in scene world units. Keep on surface can project moved candidates back to their receiver; painting requires projected movement when movement is nonzero.

layer.randomUI.movYMinSpin.label: Y movement min
layer.randomUI.movYMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random Y-axis translation in scene world units. Keep on surface can project moved candidates back to their receiver; painting requires projected movement when movement is nonzero.

layer.randomUI.movYMaxSpin.label: Y movement max
layer.randomUI.movYMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random Y-axis translation in scene world units. Keep on surface can project moved candidates back to their receiver; painting requires projected movement when movement is nonzero.

layer.randomUI.movZMinSpin.label: Z movement min
layer.randomUI.movZMinSpin.help: Set the lower limit of the layer's random Z-axis translation in scene world units. Keep on surface can project moved candidates back to their receiver; painting requires projected movement when movement is nonzero.

layer.randomUI.movZMaxSpin.label: Z movement max
layer.randomUI.movZMaxSpin.help: Set the upper limit of the layer's random Z-axis translation in scene world units. Keep on surface can project moved candidates back to their receiver; painting requires projected movement when movement is nonzero.

layer.randomUI.projectCheck.label: Keep on surface
layer.randomUI.projectCheck.help: Project random movement back onto the receiving surface.

layer.randomUI.alignCheck.label: Align to normal
layer.randomUI.alignCheck.help: Blend the preferred up axis from world Z toward the surface normal. Direction modes use it to control roll. Slope eligibility is independent.

layer.randomUI.resetRotation.label: Reset rotation
layer.randomUI.resetRotation.help: Reset only this layer's random rotation limits. Undo is available.

layer.randomUI.resetScale.label: Reset XYZ scale
layer.randomUI.resetScale.help: Reset only this layer's separate X, Y and Z scale limits.

layer.randomUI.resetWholeScale.label: Reset whole scale
layer.randomUI.resetWholeScale.help: Reset only this layer's uniform scale multiplier.

layer.randomUI.resetMovement.label: Reset movement
layer.randomUI.resetMovement.help: Reset only this layer's random translation limits.

layer.diversityUI.diversityRadio.label: Source assignment
layer.diversityUI.diversityRadio.help: Choose weighted Random mix, assignment-group Clusters, closed Spline bands or published Surface Analyzer guides. Layout chooses source assignment and supported guide anchors; it is separate from Amount and Texture Density.

layer.diversityUI.selectAnalyzer.label: Select
layer.diversityUI.selectAnalyzer.help: Select the linked Surface Analyzer in the scene.

layer.diversityUI.updateAnalyzer.label: Update Analyzer
layer.diversityUI.updateAnalyzer.help: Analyze the linked guide. In Manual mode, use Update scatter afterwards to publish placements.

layer.diversityUI.divSeedSpin.label: Seed
layer.diversityUI.divSeedSpin.help: Change source assignment randomness without changing the generation seed.

layer.diversityUI.roughSpin.label: Roughness %
layer.diversityUI.roughSpin.help: Warp the spatial assignment-group field to make cluster boundaries more irregular. This changes model-group choice, not a mesh surface or material texture.

layer.diversityUI.blurSpin.label: Blur edge %
layer.diversityUI.blurSpin.help: Mix assignments near neighboring cluster boundaries by probabilistically choosing the adjacent group. This is source-assignment blending, not geometric or image blur.

layer.diversityUI.noiseSpin.label: Noise %
layer.diversityUI.noiseSpin.help: Allow a percentage of clustered assignments to choose a weighted group independently of the local cluster. It changes model choice rather than adding candidate-position jitter.

layer.diversityUI.analyzerChannel.label: Analyzer data
layer.diversityUI.analyzerChannel.help: Choose Border, Centerline, Points, Street Side or Edge Border. Available band/row actions change by channel; Analyzer guides must be current before Scatter can calculate a successor.

layer.diversityUI.pickAnalyzer.label: Pick Surface Analyzer
layer.diversityUI.pickAnalyzer.help: Use Surface Analyzer output for bands, rows and fixed anchors.

layer.diversityUI.pickPath.label: Add: pick closed line
layer.diversityUI.pickPath.help: Link a closed spline for Spline bands using top-down world-XY projection. It is an assignment guide, not a Paint Area or receiving surface.

layer.diversityUI.removePath.label: Remove path
layer.diversityUI.removePath.help: Remove the selected assignment path while keeping the scene spline.

layer.diversityUI.strokesList.label: Bands / Analyzer rows
layer.diversityUI.strokesList.help: Select a saved Band or Analyzer row. Consecutive Bands reserve ordered intervals; Independent Bands combine eligible density contributions. These are layout records, not Brush strokes.

layer.diversityUI.addOutside.label: Add Outside / Analyzer band or radius
layer.diversityUI.addOutside.help: For Spline bands, add the next outside strip. Analyzer Centerline uses Add band and Points uses Add Radius; applicable Border, Street Side and Edge Border channels use their inside/row action instead.

layer.diversityUI.addInside.label: Add Inside / Analyzer row or single anchor
layer.diversityUI.addInside.help: For Spline bands, add the next inside strip. In Analyzer mode this creates the applicable inside band, Street Side band, Edge Border row, or a Single fixed placement at each Analyzer point.

layer.diversityUI.removeStrokeButton.label: Remove band
layer.diversityUI.removeStrokeButton.help: Remove the selected band and its settings.

layer.diversityUI.strokeWidth.label: Band width / Edge Border spacing
layer.diversityUI.strokeWidth.help: Set the selected spline band's world-space strip width, independent of spline node scale. Analyzer bands use the displayed channel width/spread; Edge Border changes this field to row Spacing, while Single point anchors have no editable width.

layer.diversityUI.strokeMode.label: Assign by
layer.diversityUI.strokeMode.help: Choose assignment Color groups or explicit Source objects for the selected band. Identification colors are separate; Point placeholders currently require Color groups because Source objects stores scene-node links.

layer.diversityUI.strokeChoices.label: Click to toggle
layer.diversityUI.strokeChoices.help: Click a model, Point or assignment group to add it to this Band; click it again to remove it. Clearing the last selection leaves the Band empty and preserves its interval. Manual applies the change on Update.

layer.diversityUI.strokeScaleMin.label: Scale min
layer.diversityUI.strokeScaleMin.help: Set the lower limit of the selected band's scale multiplier. It combines with the instance's other scale settings; it does not change the band width.

layer.diversityUI.strokeScaleMax.label: Scale max
layer.diversityUI.strokeScaleMax.help: Set the upper limit of the selected band's scale multiplier. Matching limits make its band-scale contribution fixed.

layer.diversityUI.refreshGroups.label: Refresh sources / groups
layer.diversityUI.refreshGroups.help: Refresh available source color groups for assignment.

layer.diversityUI.edgeOffsetSpin.label: Offset inward
layer.diversityUI.edgeOffsetSpin.help: Offset the selected Edge Border row along its final local facing. Positive inward moves backward along the model's chosen forward axis; this translates placements rather than resampling an inset contour.

layer.diversityUI.edgeAlongSpin.label: Jitter along
layer.diversityUI.edgeAlongSpin.help: Add bounded jitter along the selected Edge Border row. Zero keeps its generated along-boundary positions exact; spacing still controls row count.

layer.diversityUI.edgeAcrossSpin.label: Jitter across
layer.diversityUI.edgeAcrossSpin.help: Add bounded jitter across the selected Edge Border row. Zero removes this variation; later receiver and area eligibility still apply.

layer.diversityUI.keepCornerCheck.label: Keep corner points
layer.diversityUI.keepCornerCheck.help: Add and preserve qualifying corners during Edge Border base-row generation. This does not exempt those placements from later masks, spacing or cleanup.

layer.diversityUI.cornerAngleSpin.label: Min turn
layer.diversityUI.cornerAngleSpin.help: Set the minimum change in boundary direction, in degrees, for a qualifying Edge Border corner. Straight is zero; the control is used when Keep corner points is enabled.

layer.diversityUI.cornerCountSpin.label: Points/corner
layer.diversityUI.cornerCountSpin.help: Set the bounded number of added samples for each qualifying Edge Border corner. It does not guarantee that all samples survive later acceptance rules.

layer.diversityUI.edgeRotXSpin.label: Local X (deg)
layer.diversityUI.edgeRotXSpin.help: Apply an additional local X rotation, in degrees, to the selected Edge Border row's final orientation.

layer.diversityUI.edgeRotYSpin.label: Local Y (deg)
layer.diversityUI.edgeRotYSpin.help: Apply an additional local Y rotation, in degrees, to the selected Edge Border row's final orientation.

layer.diversityUI.edgeRotZSpin.label: Local Z (deg)
layer.diversityUI.edgeRotZSpin.help: Apply an additional local Z rotation, in degrees, to the selected Edge Border row's final orientation.

layer.diversityUI.streetStartSpin.label: Trim start
layer.diversityUI.streetStartSpin.help: Trim this distance from the start of connected Street Side chains. Start follows Analyzer traversal direction, not screen left; closed loops have no endpoints to trim.

layer.diversityUI.streetEndSpin.label: Trim end
layer.diversityUI.streetEndSpin.help: Trim this distance from the end of connected Street Side chains. End follows Analyzer traversal direction, not screen right; closed loops have no endpoints to trim.

layer.diversityUI.centerStreetSpin.label: Street offset
layer.diversityUI.centerStreetSpin.help: Shift the centre-line guide in world XY relative to the nearest street: positive away, negative toward. Nonzero offset requires street data; the Analyzer Area mask shares this layer setting.

layer.diversityUI.faceOutCheck.label: Face outward
layer.diversityUI.faceOutCheck.help: Orient applicable Analyzer Border, Street Side or Edge Border models outward using each model's Forward axis. Hole boundaries face into the hole; this is orientation, not a new allowed domain.

layer.diversityUI.cornerRadiusSpin.label: Corner radius / Blend radius
layer.diversityUI.cornerRadiusSpin.help: Blend outward facing near adjacent Analyzer edges. Edge Border labels this Blend radius. It changes orientation rather than the spline outline; a local offset can therefore move final positions as facing changes.

layer.diversityUI.straightStreet.label: Straight ends (Street Side)
layer.diversityUI.straightStreet.help: Restrict Street Side bands to the projected extents of their selected segments, producing straight ends rather than extending beyond endpoints. It does not trim the Analyzer publication itself.

layer.proceduralUI.scopeList.label: Edit default rule
layer.proceduralUI.scopeList.help: Edit the selected layer’s within-layer or layer-pair defaults. Each model independently inherits or overrides its own-copy, same-layer and other-layer requests.
layer.proceduralUI.scopeList.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.proceduralUI.peerList.label: Other owner
layer.proceduralUI.peerList.help: Choose the other layer for a Between layers spacing rule. Within this layer has no peer; pair rules require another owning layer.
layer.proceduralUI.peerList.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.proceduralUI.enabledCheck.label: Enable this spacing
layer.proceduralUI.enabledCheck.help: Enable this selected layer-default relationship. Explicit model clearance requests remain independently authored in Models & Points.
layer.proceduralUI.enabledCheck.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.proceduralUI.multiplierSpin.label: Radius factor
layer.proceduralUI.multiplierSpin.help: For this selected layer-default rule, clearance = factor × (radius A + radius B) + gap. Models can independently override their relevant scopes. Radii are simplified pivot footprints.
layer.proceduralUI.multiplierSpin.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.proceduralUI.gapSpin.label: Extra gap
layer.proceduralUI.gapSpin.help: Add an extra world-space gap after the radius contribution for the selected spacing relationship. This does not alter the saved source radii.
layer.proceduralUI.gapSpin.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.proceduralUI.planarCheck.label: XY distance (off = 3D)
layer.proceduralUI.planarCheck.help: Use XY distance for the selected spacing rule, ignoring height separation. Off uses full 3D centre distance; this setting is independent of cleanup neighborhoods.
layer.proceduralUI.planarCheck.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.proceduralUI.resetRule.label: Use inherited / default
layer.proceduralUI.resetRule.help: For Within this layer, remove the explicit self-rule override and restore the saved default. For Between layers, remove the selected explicit pair rule. Other rules remain unchanged.
layer.proceduralUI.resetRule.owner_context: Selected within-layer or layer-pair spacing rule

layer.instanceRadiusUI.radiusMode.label: Selected CS Edit instances
layer.instanceRadiusUI.radiusMode.help: Use an absolute world radius or multiply the selected instances' source radius.
layer.instanceRadiusUI.radiusMode.owner_context: Selected layer / stable published instance binding

layer.instanceRadiusUI.radiusSpin.label: Selected instance-radius value
layer.instanceRadiusUI.radiusSpin.help: Value applied only when Set selected radii is pressed.
layer.instanceRadiusUI.radiusSpin.owner_context: Selected layer / stable published instance binding

layer.instanceRadiusUI.applyRadius.label: Set selected radii
layer.instanceRadiusUI.applyRadius.help: Apply radius overrides to selected instances in this layer.
layer.instanceRadiusUI.applyRadius.owner_context: Selected layer / stable published instance binding

layer.instanceRadiusUI.resetRadius.label: Clear selected overrides
layer.instanceRadiusUI.resetRadius.help: Restore the selected instances' inherited source radii.
layer.instanceRadiusUI.resetRadius.owner_context: Selected layer / stable published instance binding

layer.instanceRadiusUI.clearRadius.label: Clear radius overrides
layer.instanceRadiusUI.clearRadius.help: Remove instance-radius overrides for this layer.
layer.instanceRadiusUI.clearRadius.owner_context: Selected layer / stable published instance binding

layer.spacingUI.relaxCheck.label: Point Relax
layer.spacingUI.relaxCheck.help: Enable candidate separation for this layer. Find Point Relax directly in Spacing & cleanup above Advanced. Candidate movement precedes Painting, artist edits and clearance.

layer.spacingUI.spacingSpin.label: Relax distance
layer.spacingUI.spacingSpin.help: Layer-owned distance shared by both Relax modes: desired candidate separation for Point Relax and neighbor-search radius for Boundary Relax. It is editable when either mode is on; later clearance still filters the moved candidates.

layer.spacingUI.iterationsSpin.label: Iterations
layer.spacingUI.iterationsSpin.help: Set the number of bounded Point Relax iterations. More iterations can add calculation work; masks, painting, artist edits and collision acceptance still follow.

layer.spacingUI.strengthSpin.label: Strength %
layer.spacingUI.strengthSpin.help: Set Point Relax movement strength as a percentage. This adjusts the relaxation step rather than a source weight or paint density.

layer.spacingUI.boundaryRelaxCheck.label: Boundary Relax
layer.spacingUI.boundaryRelaxCheck.help: Enable bounded candidate-neighborhood smoothing independently of Point Relax. Its settings appear directly in Spacing & cleanup, and use the shared Relax distance for neighbor search.

layer.spacingUI.finalStrengthSpin.label: Strength
layer.spacingUI.finalStrengthSpin.help: Set the 0–1 smoothing strength for Boundary Relax. This acts on candidate neighborhoods before final eligibility and artist edits.

layer.spacingUI.finalIterSpin.label: Iterations
layer.spacingUI.finalIterSpin.help: Set the bounded Boundary Relax iteration count. Zero disables its iterations; this is separate from Point Relax iterations.

layer.spacingUI.finalMoveSpin.label: Max movement
layer.spacingUI.finalMoveSpin.help: Limit Boundary Relax displacement with a world-space maximum movement. It does not override later surface/area eligibility or collision rules.

layer.separationUI.cleanCheck.label: Remove isolated plants
layer.separationUI.cleanCheck.help: Remove isolated plants after spacing. Protected instance edits remain.

layer.separationUI.neighborSpin.label: Neighbor distance
layer.separationUI.neighborSpin.help: Set the neighborhood-search distance for cleanup after spacing. This determines which plants count as neighbors or connected islands; it is not a collision radius.

layer.separationUI.minNeighborSpin.label: Minimum neighbors
layer.separationUI.minNeighborSpin.help: Remove unprotected plants with fewer than this many nearby neighbors. Zero disables the minimum-neighbor requirement; protected artist edits remain.

layer.separationUI.minIslandSpin.label: Minimum island size
layer.separationUI.minIslandSpin.help: Remove unprotected connected planting islands smaller than this many plants. Zero disables the minimum-island requirement; Retry cleanup gaps is a separate bounded population option.

layer.separationUI.planarCheck.label: XY neighborhoods (off = 3D)
layer.separationUI.planarCheck.help: Measure cleanup neighborhoods in world XY, ignoring height. Off uses 3D distance. This choice is independent of each spacing rule's XY/3D setting.

layer.detailsUI.refreshButton.label: Read cached statistics
layer.detailsUI.refreshButton.help: Read the named layer's last completed calculation and prepared preview counts without regenerating placements. Pending Manual settings remain unapplied.

layer.detailsUI.helpButton.label: Layer / display help
layer.detailsUI.helpButton.help: Explain settings ownership, display budgets, evaluation order and policy limits.

container.properties.enabledCheck.label: Enable collection
container.properties.enabledCheck.help: Collect models whose pivots are inside this rectangle. Off lets you position it without collecting or moving models. Manual mode needs Update.

container.properties.consumerList.label: Edit linked Scatter layer
container.properties.consumerList.help: Choose a linked setup or layer. Inactive pools remain editable; this changes the view only.

container.properties.widthSpin.label: Container width
container.properties.widthSpin.help: Resize the boundary. Source models keep their transforms.

container.properties.lengthSpin.label: Container length
container.properties.lengthSpin.help: Resize the source rectangle's length in scene units. This changes its collection footprint without scaling or translating source models.

container.properties.labelCheck.label: Show viewport label
container.properties.labelCheck.help: Show or hide the rectangle's cached viewport label. It does not enable collection or recalculate the Scatter result.

container.properties.sourceList.label: Active / parked source models
container.properties.sourceList.help: List saved source models as Active or Parked. Active requires enabled collection and a pivot inside the rectangle; select a row before assigning movement ownership.

container.properties.assignOwner.label: Follow this container
container.properties.assignOwner.help: Make the highlighted model follow this container when supported container movement occurs, resolving overlapping movement ownership. Its use and per-layer settings in other consumers remain unchanged.

general.host.licenseButton.label: License / activationÃ¢â‚¬Â¦
general.host.licenseButton.help: Open the local team-license activation and status dialog. Import a returned license or inspect its expiry. Existing scenes remain loadable and renderable after expiry; supported creation and editing require a valid license.

general.previewUI.radiusMetricDrop.label: Radius display metric
general.previewUI.radiusMetricDrop.help: Inspect the published XY radius as one ring or the 3D radius as three perpendicular rings. This display choice does not change spacing rules.

layer.sourceUI.radiusModeDrop.label: Radius mode
layer.sourceUI.radiusModeDrop.help: Manual preserves your radius and Follow Scale settings. Auto derives conservative pivot-centered XY/3D bounds from supported source geometry after final scale and orientation. Points, Empty and unqualified source types use Manual.

layer.diversityUI.pathsList.label: Paths
layer.diversityUI.pathsList.help: Select a saved Path to inspect its Bands. Missing Paths stay visible as inactive references; identical names do not merge their identities.

layer.diversityUI.cornerMode.label: Path corners
layer.diversityUI.cornerMode.help: Rounded uses distance to the original border segments. Sharp uses bounded miter offsets; acute corners are limited and overly complex Paths can require simplification.

layer.diversityUI.arrangementMode.label: Band ranges
layer.diversityUI.arrangementMode.help: Consecutive accumulates widths and reserves empty intervals. Independent uses each Band's Start/End and allows shared density contributions. Independent and nontrivial density require Candidate budget.

layer.diversityUI.bandStart.label: Start
layer.diversityUI.bandStart.help: Near boundary of this Independent Band, measured as a physical distance from its Path on the chosen side.

layer.diversityUI.bandEnd.label: End
layer.diversityUI.bandEnd.help: Far boundary of this Independent Band. End must be greater than Start; other Bands can overlap this interval.

layer.diversityUI.bandStrength.label: Density
layer.diversityUI.bandStrength.help: Scale this Band's contribution before other masks and spacing. Independent contributions combine up to 100% occupancy and share one candidate population.

layer.diversityUI.bandCurveCheck.label: Use density curve
layer.diversityUI.bandCurveCheck.help: Multiply Band density by its saved sampled curve, progressing from the Start boundary to End.

layer.diversityUI.bandCurveEdit.label: Edit density curve
layer.diversityUI.bandCurveEdit.help: Edit the captured Band's density curve. The applied sampled trace is the calculation input; edits apply on drag release, Apply or Close.

layer.diversityUI.bandColor.label: Band color
layer.diversityUI.bandColor.help: Identification color for this Band. Color by Bands uses the accepted owner; changing the color does not change placements or source render materials.

layer.diversityUI.fieldFalloffCheck.label: Preview Falloff
layer.diversityUI.fieldFalloffCheck.help: Show bounded density samples on receiver surfaces before other masks, spacing and cleanup. Blue is zero and red is 100%; samples are approximate coverage, not the final plant count.

layer.diversityUI.fieldBoundaryCheck.label: Show Boundaries
layer.diversityUI.fieldBoundaryCheck.help: Show white admitted start/end contours clipped to receiver surfaces, including stacked elevations and vertical faces. Lines remain separate from render output.

layer.diversityUI.fieldView.label: Field view
layer.diversityUI.fieldView.help: Selected Band shows its contribution; Combined density shows capped total occupancy. Manual pending feedback is labeled separately from plants at the last Update.

layer.diversityUI.fieldSampleSpin.label: Field samples
layer.diversityUI.fieldSampleSpin.help: Use 1–20,000 bounded visualization samples. Sparse samples can miss narrow intervals; Show Boundaries displays admitted outlines independently.

layer.diversityUI.bandUp.label: Move Band up
layer.diversityUI.bandUp.help: Move the selected Band earlier on its Path. Consecutive ranges and first-match priority follow authored order.

layer.diversityUI.bandDown.label: Move Band down
layer.diversityUI.bandDown.help: Move the selected Band later on its Path. Independent decisions retain stable Band identities.

layer.sourceUI.makePoint.label: Make point
layer.sourceUI.makePoint.help: Use one selected model row as a Point without deleting the scene object. Retain its identity, settings and Band assignments, and its source registration so container scans cannot duplicate it. Auto radius is inactive while the row is a Point.

layer.diversityUI.bandScaleMode.label: Scale profile
layer.diversityUI.bandScaleMode.help: Off retains random Band sizing. Follow Density multiplies size by the effective density curve shape, excluding Density %. Custom uses an independent scale graph. Stored Custom curves survive mode changes.

layer.diversityUI.bandScaleEdit.label: Edit scale curve
layer.diversityUI.bandScaleEdit.help: Edit the selected Band size profile. X runs from Start to End; Y is size percent. 100% preserves size, 50% halves it. Manual waits for Update scatter. The editor retains its captured Band identity across selection changes.

general.previewUI.navigationPointsSpin.label: Navigating points
general.previewUI.navigationPointsSpin.help: Maximum Point Cloud or centre markers while navigating, across visible layers. Zero removes the display cap.

general.previewUI.navigationInstancesSpi.label: Navigating instances
general.previewUI.navigationInstancesSpi.help: Maximum proxy instances while navigating, across visible layers. Zero removes the display cap.

general.previewUI.navigationFacesSpin.label: Navigating triangles
general.previewUI.navigationFacesSpin.help: Maximum Mesh triangles while navigating, across visible layers. Expensive sources may use cached boxes. Zero removes the display cap.

layer.distributionUI.presetsButton.label: Presets...
layer.distributionUI.presetsButton.help: Save or apply named population settings to the captured layer or spacing scope. Selecting a library item is passive. Apply preserves assets and receiver references, supports one Undo, and respects Manual/Live updates.

layer.randomUI.presetsButton.label: Presets...
layer.randomUI.presetsButton.help: Save or apply named transforms settings to the captured layer or spacing scope. Selecting a library item is passive. Apply preserves assets and receiver references, supports one Undo, and respects Manual/Live updates.

layer.proceduralUI.presetsButton.label: Presets...
layer.proceduralUI.presetsButton.help: Save or apply named spacing settings to the captured layer or spacing scope. Selecting a library item is passive. Apply preserves assets and receiver references, supports one Undo, and respects Manual/Live updates.

layer.areaUI.slopeCheck.label: Filter slope
layer.areaUI.slopeCheck.help: Eligibility from world up: 0 degrees upward, 90 vertical, 180 underside. Protected Edit plants are retained.

layer.areaUI.slopeMinSpin.label: Min slope:
layer.areaUI.slopeMinSpin.help: Minimum slope in degrees. Zero inside fade includes this endpoint.

layer.areaUI.slopeMaxSpin.label: Max slope:
layer.areaUI.slopeMaxSpin.help: Maximum slope in degrees; plant alignment does not affect surface slope.

layer.areaUI.slopeLowerSpin.label: Lower fade:
layer.areaUI.slopeLowerSpin.help: Inside fade above the minimum, in degrees. Fades must not overlap.

layer.areaUI.slopeUpperSpin.label: Upper fade:
layer.areaUI.slopeUpperSpin.help: Inside fade below the maximum, in degrees. Fades must not overlap.

layer.areaUI.altitudeCheck.label: Filter altitude
layer.areaUI.altitudeCheck.help: World Z eligibility. Fades reduce density inside the range; source Z offsets do not change eligibility.

layer.areaUI.altitudeMinSpin.label: Min height:
layer.areaUI.altitudeMinSpin.help: Minimum world Z of the final receiver anchor, before source offsets.

layer.areaUI.altitudeMaxSpin.label: Max height:
layer.areaUI.altitudeMaxSpin.help: Maximum world Z of the final receiver anchor, in scene units.

layer.areaUI.altitudeLowerSpin.label: Lower fade:
layer.areaUI.altitudeLowerSpin.help: Inside fade above minimum height. Zero keeps the hard endpoint.

layer.areaUI.altitudeUpperSpin.label: Upper fade:
layer.areaUI.altitudeUpperSpin.help: Inside fade below maximum height. Fades must not overlap.

layer.distributionUI.uvChannelSpin.label: UV channel
layer.distributionUI.uvChannelSpin.help: Choose receiver texture channel 1..99, default 1. Every receiver must have valid mapping in that channel. Errors retain the preceding complete planting.

layer.distributionUI.resolutionList.label: Map resolution
layer.distributionUI.resolutionList.help: Choose 64, 128, 256 or 512 samples per side. Default 128. Higher resolution can capture narrow features but increases preparation time and memory. Valid sampled maps are reused across receiver edits.

layer.brushUI.exportSpline.label: Export spline
layer.brushUI.exportSpline.help: Open Optimized and Exact snapshot export options. Optimized reduces planar spline knots within the world-unit deviation limit, initially 1 mm, and reports the result. Attached-surface borders default to Exact; uncertifiable reductions retain Exact geometry. Original Paint and completed plants stay unchanged. Stop the brush first.

layer.brushUI.importMode.label: Spline import
layer.brushUI.importMode.help: Replace sets the selected area's coverage. Add unions the imported region with existing paint. Closed contours use even-odd fill, project along receiver-local Z and clip to the receiver.

layer.brushUI.splineTolerance.label: Curve tolerance:
layer.brushUI.splineTolerance.help: World-unit approximation distance, initially 1 mm. Smaller values need more samples; at most 8,192 knots and sampled vertices. Transformed Paint precision sets a minimum.

layer.brushUI.importSpline.label: Pick spline...
layer.brushUI.importSpline.help: Apply closed spline coverage using Replace or Add. Curved borders must lie on the receiver within Curve tolerance; edited closed-surface borders select the smaller enclosed region. One Undo; Manual waits for Update. Stop the brush first.

layer.distributionUI.meshCheck.label: Use surface density
layer.distributionUI.meshCheck.help: Enable the independent channel or relative-elevation field.
layer.distributionUI.meshCheck.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshChannelSpin.label: Channel
layer.distributionUI.meshChannelSpin.help: 0 reads vertex colors; 1..99 read numbered mesh map channels. These are values, independent of density UV coordinates.
layer.distributionUI.meshChannelSpin.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshComponentList.label: Component
layer.distributionUI.meshComponentList.help: Read one component of the selected mesh channel. Match Data Channel's Vertex Output component.
layer.distributionUI.meshComponentList.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshMinSpin.label: Input min
layer.distributionUI.meshMinSpin.help: Channel value mapped to 0 before Invert and the Density curve. Must be less than Input max.
layer.distributionUI.meshMinSpin.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshMaxSpin.label: Input max
layer.distributionUI.meshMaxSpin.help: Channel value mapped to 1 before Invert and the Density curve. Values outside the range clamp.
layer.distributionUI.meshMaxSpin.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshInvertCheck.label: Invert mesh mask
layer.distributionUI.meshInvertCheck.help: Reverse the normalized channel values before applying the Density curve.
layer.distributionUI.meshInvertCheck.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshCurveButton.label: Density curve...
layer.distributionUI.meshCurveButton.help: Remap normalized mesh values into planting eligibility. Left is 0; right is 1.
layer.distributionUI.meshCurveButton.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshPreviewButton.label: Preview mask
layer.distributionUI.meshPreviewButton.help: Read a snapshot of the current mask as at most 2,048 grayscale face-centre markers. White permits plants; black excludes. Refresh after edits.
layer.distributionUI.meshPreviewButton.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

layer.distributionUI.meshHideButton.label: Hide preview
layer.distributionUI.meshHideButton.help: Hide the cached mesh mask markers without recalculating plants.
layer.distributionUI.meshHideButton.owner_context: Selected layer and its receiving surfaces

general.manager.recipesButton.label: Recipes...
general.manager.recipesButton.help: Save selected layers as a complete static recipe, including Paint, or review scene bindings and import a saved recipe as new layers or a new setup. Browsing does not calculate plants. External assets remain scene roles; unsupported authored data blocks complete save.

layer.randomUI.orientationList.label: Orientation mode
layer.randomUI.orientationList.help: Random keeps the usual random rotation frame. World direction or Look at target sets the heading before local random rotations. Models use local +Z up and their Source Forward axis.

layer.randomUI.normalBlendSpin.label: Normal %
layer.randomUI.normalBlendSpin.help: 0 keeps world +Z as preferred up; 100 follows the geometric face normal. Between them uses an angular blend. In direction modes this controls roll.

layer.randomUI.directionXSpin.label: World direction X
layer.randomUI.directionXSpin.help: World direction X component. The vector needs at least one nonzero component. Its length does not affect the result.

layer.randomUI.directionYSpin.label: World direction Y
layer.randomUI.directionYSpin.help: World direction Y component. This is a direction, not a position or distance.

layer.randomUI.directionZSpin.label: World direction Z
layer.randomUI.directionZSpin.help: World direction Z component. Nonzero values can aim models above or below the horizon.

layer.randomUI.targetPickButton.label: Pick orientation target
layer.randomUI.targetPickButton.help: Aim each plant at a scene object's pivot. Its transform is used; its geometry is not read. Relevant target or parent motion updates Live.

layer.randomUI.targetClearButton.label: Clear orientation target
layer.randomUI.targetClearButton.help: Clear this layer's target reference. Look at target needs a valid target before Update can publish.

general.manager.copyVariation.label: Copy variation
general.manager.copyVariation.help: Same keeps receiver random inputs; New chooses fresh inputs once when Copy runs. Both create independent layer data and Paint. Exact output still depends on matching terrain, source order, masks, quotas and collision context. Changing this choice does not calculate scatter.

layer.placementUI.generatorList.label: Planting positions
layer.placementUI.generatorList.help: Choose Surface random, Rectangular, Staggered or Hexagonal. Grids project down onto the highest world-Z hit per receiver. Source assignment remains independent; Analyzer Single/EdgeRow cannot replace grid positions.

layer.placementUI.columnSpin.label: Column spacing
layer.placementUI.columnSpin.help: World distance between columns. For Hexagonal this is the nearest-neighbor spacing; row pitch is calculated. Pitch sets population, so Count/Density and refill controls are inactive.

layer.placementUI.rowSpin.label: Row spacing
layer.placementUI.rowSpin.help: World distance between Rectangular or Staggered rows. Staggered offsets alternate rows by half a column. Hidden in Hexagonal mode, whose row pitch is calculated.

layer.placementUI.originXSpin.label: Grid origin X
layer.placementUI.originXSpin.help: World X coordinate of the fixed lattice frame. Changing receiver bounds or masks does not move this origin.

layer.placementUI.originYSpin.label: Grid origin Y
layer.placementUI.originYSpin.help: World Y coordinate of the fixed lattice frame. Every receiver in this layer uses the same frame.

layer.placementUI.headingSpin.label: Grid heading
layer.placementUI.headingSpin.help: Rotate the lattice around world Z at its explicit origin. Projection remains vertical.

layer.placementUI.jitterSpin.label: Grid jitter
layer.placementUI.jitterSpin.help: Stable displacement per cell: 0% gives exact lattice points; 100% permits up to half a pitch along each grid axis. Masks do not reroll surviving unrelaxed cells.

layer.distributionUI.mapBrowseButton.label: Map
layer.distributionUI.mapBrowseButton.help: Choose a texture map or drag one from the Material Editor, including when empty. Drag the TextureMap itself rather than a complete material; supported procedural maps show a cached thumbnail. Use Show mask to inspect receiver-dependent output.

layer.distributionUI.imageCheck.label: Use image
layer.distributionUI.imageCheck.help: Enable the chosen pattern, image or texture map. White permits plants; black excludes them. Independent of the mesh-channel mask.

layer.distributionUI.patternButton.label: Choose pattern...
layer.distributionUI.patternButton.help: Browse original Cyrus masks. Choosing one changes only image density.

layer.distributionUI.imageButton.label: Image
layer.distributionUI.imageButton.help: Choose an image file, read as linear density data.

layer.distributionUI.imageThumbnail.label: Image preview
layer.distributionUI.imageThumbnail.help: Complete density image tile. Procedural maps remain editable; use Show mask to inspect their evaluated field.

layer.distributionUI.coordinatesList.label: Coordinates
layer.distributionUI.coordinatesList.help: Map coordinates uses the texture graph’s own receiver UV/data channels. Other modes project a sampled image.

layer.distributionUI.tileLockCheck.label: Lock X / Y size
layer.distributionUI.tileLockCheck.help: Use equal physical sizes or UV repeats in both axes.

layer.distributionUI.wrappingList.label: Tile edges
layer.distributionUI.wrappingList.help: Repeat wraps the pattern across seams. Clamp extends its outside pixels.

layer.distributionUI.imageCurveButton.label: Density curve...
layer.distributionUI.imageCurveButton.help: Remap image values after inversion. Height is planting eligibility.

layer.distributionUI.bakeImageButton.label: Bake portable snapshot...
layer.distributionUI.bakeImageButton.help: Explicitly replace a live map with a saved 2D image tile for portable recipes. Undo restores the original graph.

layer.distributionUI.maskViewList.label: Mask view
layer.distributionUI.maskViewList.help: Combined includes image, mesh density, Paint, include/exclude areas and terrain eligibility before collisions, spacing and count limits.

layer.distributionUI.maskDetailList.label: Preview detail
layer.distributionUI.maskDetailList.help: Bounded surface tessellation independent of plant count. Increase for dense meshes.

layer.distributionUI.opacitySpin.label: Opacity %:
layer.distributionUI.opacitySpin.help: Change mask visibility only; plants are unchanged.

layer.distributionUI.markersCheck.label: Show sample markers
layer.distributionUI.markersCheck.help: Diagnostic samples in place of the continuous surface mask. Does not change planting.

layer.distributionUI.markerSizeList.label: Marker size
layer.distributionUI.markerSizeList.help: Diagnostic marker size only. Does not resample the field or recalculate plants.

layer.distributionUI.tileXSpin.label: Tile X:
layer.distributionUI.tileXSpin.help: Physical width of one tile. Image resolution changes detail, not size.

layer.distributionUI.tileYSpin.label: Tile Y:
layer.distributionUI.tileYSpin.help: Physical height when size is unlocked.

layer.distributionUI.headingSpin.label: Heading:
layer.distributionUI.headingSpin.help: Pattern rotation in degrees about the projection origin.

layer.distributionUI.offsetXSpin.label: Offset X:
layer.distributionUI.offsetXSpin.help: Shift the projection origin in scene units before rotation.

layer.distributionUI.offsetYSpin.label: Offset Y:
layer.distributionUI.offsetYSpin.help: Shift the projection origin in scene units before rotation.

layer.distributionUI.offsetUSpin.label: Offset U:
layer.distributionUI.offsetUSpin.help: Shift the UV origin before rotation and repeats.

layer.distributionUI.offsetVSpin.label: Offset V:
layer.distributionUI.offsetVSpin.help: Shift the UV origin before rotation and repeats.

layer.distributionUI.meshSourceList.label: Field
layer.distributionUI.meshSourceList.help: Choose an authored mesh channel or relative local elevation. Elevation uses 0 at the lowest referenced vertex and 1 at the highest; flat terrain is 0.

general.surface.surfaceVisibility.label: Hide surface / Show surface
general.surface.surfaceVisibility.help: Hide selected receiving surfaces in viewports while keeping painting and rendering. The preference belongs to each scene node, is shared across setups using it, and supports Undo and scene saving.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceCopiesList.label: Own copies
layer.sourceUI.clearanceCopiesList.help: Choose whether this model inherits the layer rule, makes no own-copy request, or requests space between its own instances.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceOthersList.label: Other models in this layer
layer.sourceUI.clearanceOthersList.help: Set this model’s request independently for other sources in the same layer. Keep apart uses the sum of both effective radii.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceExternalList.label: Other layers
layer.sourceUI.clearanceExternalList.help: Independently inherit, turn off this request, or keep this model clear of selected or all other layers in this Scatter setup.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceLayerList.label: Target layers
layer.sourceUI.clearanceLayerList.help: Select other layers for this model’s Selected layers request. Persistent layer identity survives renaming; removing a target makes that relationship inactive.

layer.sourceUI.clearancePriorityList.label: Conflict priority
layer.sourceUI.clearancePriorityList.help: Prefer this model wins conflicts against normal models after Count admission. Protected artist edits win first; preference does not take extra Count slots.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceFactorSpin.label: Radius factor
layer.sourceUI.clearanceFactorSpin.help: For this model’s explicit clearance requests, multiply the sum of both effective radii, then add Extra gap. Inherited scopes keep their layer-rule distances.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceGapSpin.label: Extra gap
layer.sourceUI.clearanceGapSpin.help: Add a world-space gap to this model’s explicit clearance distance. This does not change either saved source radius.

layer.sourceUI.clearanceMetricList.label: Measure distance
layer.sourceUI.clearanceMetricList.help: Use full 3D distance or XY ground-plane distance for this model’s explicit clearance requests. XY can reject points at different heights.

layer.sourceUI.showSources.label: Show sources
layer.sourceUI.showSources.help: Unhide the selected scene source nodes in one Undo. Their renderable flags are preserved. Layer, group and category visibility restrictions remain.

layer.sourceUI.hideSources.label: Hide sources
layer.sourceUI.hideSources.help: Hide the selected scene source nodes in one Undo. Keep materials, registration, renderable flags and completed placements.

layer.sourceUI.editMaterial.label: Edit material
layer.sourceUI.editMaterial.help: Open the selected model's assigned scene material in Slate. Shared material instances change together. Library asset files are kept.

general.previewUI.memoryButton.label: Viewport memory…
general.previewUI.memoryButton.help: Choose Automatic or a Custom 256–65,536 MiB Mesh memory allowance for this Max installation. It is shared across Scatter controllers and is separate from scene/recipe settings. It affects future admission without calculating planting; Refresh display retries published results while preserving pending Manual placement changes. Windows/device safeguards still apply.
general.previewUI.memoryButton.owner_context: Max installation preference, shared across Scatter controllers
